vol_rle_decode — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_decode(region) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_decode(region) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, ops3d.get("vol_rle_decode"))

Usage

Decode a VolRLE back to a dense (D, H, W) float64 {0, 1} volume.

Exact inverse of vol_rle_encode (bit-identical round trip). The region is validated first, so a corrupted RLE raises ValueError instead of writing out of bounds.

Procedure: into an int8 cumulative buffer of (D*H, W+1), add +1 at each run's start and -1 at its end (np.add.at); positions where the cumulative sum along x is > 0 become foreground. Even if overlapping runs are passed, they do not cancel each other out in the addition (count > 0 means foreground).

Returns: float64 of (D, H, W), with values 0.0 / 1.0 only. shape is taken from region.shape, so the original volume is not needed.

Validation (ValueError): not a VolRLE / shape not of length 3, empty, or over MAX_VOXELS / length mismatch among rows, starts, ends / not an integer dtype / row id outside 0..D*H-1 / a run with start < 0, end > W or end <= start. Hand-made RLE and RLE read from outside are also fully checked before allocation.

Where to use it: decode only right before processing that cannot be done on runs (filters, morphology, vol_label etc.), and convert the result back with vol_rle_encode.
